content.hebrew: יֹצֵר עוֹלָמִים בְּיָהּ, וּפֹעֵל גְּבוּרוֹת,
content.transliteration: Yotser ‘olamim beYah, ufo‘el gevurot,
content.english: The creator of worlds through Yah, who performs heroic feats,

content.hebrew: צֹפֶה וּמַבִּיט עַד סוֹף כָּל־הַדּוֹרוֹת;
content.transliteration: Tsofē umabbit ‘ad sof kol haddorot;
content.english: He looks and gazes to the end of all generations;

content.hebrew: חֹקֵר לֵב, בֹּחֵן כְּלָיוֹת, וְיֹדֵֽעַ סְתוּרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Ḥoḳer lev, boḥen kelayot, veyode’a‘ seturot.
content.english: He investigates the heart, examines the kidneys, and knows [people’s] secrets.

content.hebrew: קָרָא לְנֶאֱמַן בֵּיתוֹ, וְגִלָּֽהוּ נִסְתָּרוֹת:
content.transliteration: Ḳara lene’eman beto, veḡillahu nistarot:
content.english: He called the faithful one of His house, and revealed secrets to him:
content.comments: The faithful one of His house. Moses.

content.hebrew: בָּֽאוּ יָמֶֽיךָ לָמוּת – וְקָֽמוּ דוֹרוֹת סֹרְרוֹת,
content.transliteration: Ba’u yamekha lamut – veḳamu dorot sorerot,
content.english: “Your time has come to die—and wayward generations will arise,

content.hebrew: נָטֹה יִטֶּה הָעָם הַזֶּה אַחֲרֵי אֱלִילִים וַאֲשֵׁרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Nato yittē ha‘am hazzē aḥarē elilim va’asherot.
content.english: This nation will surely turn, yes, turn, to idols and asheroth.

content.hebrew: שִׁירָה זֹאת תָּעִיד לְפָנָיו, בִּמְצֹא אֹתוֹ רָעוֹת רַבּוֹת וְצָרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Shira zot ta‘id lefanav, bimtso oto ra‘ot rabbot vetsarot.
content.english: This song will testify before them, when many evils and troubles find them.

content.hebrew: לָכֵן כִּתְבוּ הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת, וְלִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהוֹרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Lakhen kitvu hash’shira hazzot, velivnē Yisra’el lehorot.
content.english: Therefore, write this song, and teach it to the Israelites;

content.hebrew: מִפִּי זַרְעָם לֹא תִשָּׁכַח, מִדּוֹר לְדוֹרוֹת,
content.transliteration: Mippi zar‘am lo tish’shakhaḥ, middor ledorot,
content.english: It will not be forgotten from their descendants, from generation to generation.

content.hebrew: הִיא תִהְיֶה לִּי לְעֵד לְיוֹם עֲבָרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Hi tihyē li le‘ed leyom ‘avarot.
content.english: It will be a testimony, for the day of rage,

content.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְזִכָּרוֹן, בְּלִי לִפְרֹץ גְּדֵרוֹת,
content.transliteration: Velivnē venehem lezikkaron, beli lifrots gederot,
content.english: And a reminder for their children’s children, not to burst through fences,

content.hebrew: לְבַל יֵלְכוּ בְּמַחְשַׁךְ לִבָּם, אַחֲרֵי תַאֲוֹת חֲסֵרוֹת,
content.transliteration: Leval yelekhu bemaḥ’shakh libbam, aḥarē ta’avot ḥaserot,
content.english: Not to go in their heart’s darkness, after vacuous cravings;

content.hebrew: רַק לְהִתְנַהֵג בְּדַרְכֵי אֵל הַיְשָׁרוֹת,
content.transliteration: Raḳ lehitnaheḡ bedarkhē El haysharot,
content.english: Rather, they ought to conduct themselves according to God’s just ways,

content.hebrew: לִמְצֹא מַרְגּֽוֹעַ לְנַפְשָׁם, וּבְחַיֵּי עַד צְרוּרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Limtso margo’a‘ lenafsham, uvḥayyē ‘ad tserurot.
content.english: To find quiet for their soul, and be bound up in eternal life.

content.hebrew: בְּמוֹעֵד שְׁנַת הַשְּׁמִטָּה בְּחַג הַסֻּכּוֹת, אֶת־כָּל־הַתּוֹרָה לִקְרוֹת,
content.transliteration: Bemo‘ed shenat hash’shemitta beḥaḡ hassukkot, et kol hattora liḳrot,
content.english: At the time of the Sabbatical Year, on the Festival of Sukkoth, read this whole Torah

content.hebrew: בְּאָזְנֵי כָל־קְהַל יִשְֹרָאֵל, לְהָבֵר מַחְשְׁבוֹתָם הָרָעוֹת וְלִזְרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Be’oznē khol ḳehal Yisra’el, lehaver maḥ’shevotam hara‘ot velizrot.
content.english: In the ears of the whole community of Israel, to filter their evil thoughts and scatter them.

content.hebrew: הִנֵּה יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ תַּחְתָּיו, לְלַמְּדָם חֻקִּים וְתוֹרוֹת,
content.transliteration: Hinnē Yehoshu’a‘ taḥtav, lelammedam ḥuḳḳim vetorot,
content.english: Behold, Joshua [will be] in [Moses]’s place, to teach them laws and teachings,

content.hebrew: וְהוּא יַנְחִיל אֹתָם אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ הַמְיֻעֶֽדֶת בִּגְזֵרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Vehu yanḥil otam et ha’arets hamyu‘edet biḡzerot.
content.english: And he will allot them as an inheritance the Land designated [for them] with decrees.”

content.hebrew: מִי כֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ? נֹתֵן הַיְשָׁרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Mi khelohenu? Noten haysharot.
content.english: Who is like our God? He sets upright [paths].

content.hebrew: מַגִּיד מֵרֵאשִׁית אַחֲרִית, וּמַרְבֶּה אַזְהָרוֹת,
content.transliteration: Maggid mereshit aḥarit, umarbē azharot,
content.english: He foretells the end from the beginning, and gives many warnings;

content.hebrew: צְרוּפוֹת אִמְרוֹתָיו – אֲמָרוֹת טְהוֹרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Tserufot imrotav – amarot tehorot.
content.english: His utterances are refined—[they] are pure utterances.

content.hebrew: יָחִישׁ וִיקַיֵּם הַבְטָחוֹתָיו הַנִּגְזָרוֹת,
content.transliteration: Yaḥish viḳayyem havtaḥotav hanniḡzarot,
content.english: May He hasten and fulfill his decreed promises;

content.hebrew: יִגְזֹר אֹֽמֶר לְקַבֵּץ גָּלֻיוֹת פְּזוּרוֹת,
content.transliteration: Yiḡzor omer leḳabbets galuyot pezurot,
content.english: May He definitively decree to gather in the dispersed exiles;

content.hebrew: יִגְאָלֵם גְּאֻלָּה נִצְחִית, מוֹצִיא אֲסִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Yiḡ’alem ge’ulla nits’ḥit motsi asirim bakkosharot.
content.english: May He give them everlasting redemption, He who brings out prisoners from chains.

content.hebrew: נִדְחֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יְכַנֵּס לִיפֵה נֹף, מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל־עֲיָרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Nidḥē Yisra’el yekhannes lifē nof, mesos kol ‘ayarot.
content.english: The dispersed of Israel—may He bring them into the loveliest [city] in the region, the joy of all cities.

content.hebrew: וְאַהֲבָתוֹ תְּכַסֶּה עַל כָּל־פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ, בִּימֵי כַפָּרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Ve’ahavato tekhassē ‘al kol pesha‘enu, bimē kapparot,
content.english: May His love cover up all our sins, in the days of atonement.

content.hebrew: אֵין קָדוֹשׁ כַּיוי, כִּי אֵין בִּלְתּוֹ, עֹנֶה עֲתִירוֹת,
content.transliteration: En ḳadosh ka’Adonai, ki en bilto, ‘onē ‘atirot,
content.english: There is none holy like Adonai, for there is none besides Him, the one who answers supplications,

content.hebrew: קהל: כִּי הוּא קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל, יֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת וּזְמִירוֹת.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ki hu ḳedosh Yisra’el, yoshev tehillot uzmirot.
content.english: Cong. For He is the Holy One of Israel, enthroned on [their] praises and songs.

content.hebrew: חזן: אֵין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיו֖י כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּֽאלֹהֵֽינוּ: (שמואל א ב:ב)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: En ḳadosh ka’Adonai ki en biltekha ve’en tsur kelohenu:
content.english: Cantor.There is none holy like Adonai, for there is none but You; and there is no rock like our God. (1 Sam. 2:2)

content.hebrew: קהל: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (תהלים כב:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’atta ḳadosh yoshev tehillot Yisra’el:
content.english: Congregation: And You are Holy, enthroned on Israel’s praises. (Ps. 22:4)
